text:
2026 was the year I stopped only using planning software and started building my own tools.

What I built this year, working with an AI coding agent:
• A P6 baseline engine: logic, quantities and man-hours loaded from the BOQ, with S-curves and a DCMA 14-point check.
• A 4D progress model: every spool on the 3D model, coloured by its site status, with test packs ranked for hydrotest.
• A records and contract assistant that finds the clause and the letter in minutes, not days.

What I learned:
1. The tools are no longer the hard part. Knowing what to ask is.
2. A picture of the plant ends an argument faster than a table.
3. The data was always there. We had just never joined it.

Thank you to everyone who read, commented and disagreed with me this year. I learned from all three.

What did you build or learn in 2026?
